messages:
evan: flagging a creeping pending GPU queue in ap-northeast1-a. mostly 0.25/0.5 inference pods but two 8/16GPU training jobs stuck

sara: can you share a few pending pod statuses?

evan: sample:
```
Name: infer-lite-77
requests.nvidia.com/gpu: 0.25
annotations: redwood/scheduler-hint=prefer-nvlink:group-b
Status: Pending (0/40 nodes fit: Insufficient contiguous gpus)
```

ken: hmmm. scheduler logs show prefer-nvlink is high-weight and our min-fragment scorer is also strong. tiny requests are being scattered to satisfy NVLink hints and avoid breaking anchors, leaving whole 8/16 slots unusable

infra-bot: [alert] fragmentation_rise ap-northeast1-a unusable_gpus=32 anomaly=0.66 at 1767555590

evan: node layout (sanitized): node-x:8 free (anchor=family-legacy), node-y:8 free, node-z: many smalls scattered

sara: two prongs: quick mitigation + longer-term tuning. Mitigation: run targeted coalescer for fractional pods and revoke stale anchors referencing legacy families. Also lower prefer-nvlink hint weight to 0.35 temporarily.

ken: defrag dry-run: `kubectl exec -n infra-tooling coalesce --region ap-northeast1-a --filter "requests.gpu<=0.5" --dry-run`

evan: dry-run => would move 20 pods, free 2x8 slots, reduce pending by ~18%. safe limits: dont-evict-age<3m, max-evict=12%.

ops-oncall: approved conservative execute. run now and monitor evictions/events.

(1m later)

evan: ran coalescer conservative. moved 15 small pods, freed 2 contiguous 8 slots. one 16GPU training job scheduled, another 8GPU job bound. pending fell from 9->4.

sara: created INFRA-8888: "nvlink-hint+fragmentation tuning". action items: add precommit sim for combined scoring, add anchor-ttl guard (default 10m for non-critical), and make hint-weight a rollout-guarded parameter with canary metric on unusable_gpus.

ken: also propose scheduler change: prefer packing fractional requests into same nvlink-label nodes before considering cross-label placement. less risk than revoking anchors globally.

infra-bot: [note] INFRA-8888 created and assigned to eng-scheduler at 1767555605

evan: closing — cluster stabilized for now. will reopen if anomaly resurfaces. :white_check_mark:
